title: A-200 assembly & design review
registerRevision: 2026-09-10 · Physical equipment ownership and complete Explore assemblies
lead: Four-reactor GO oxidation bank R-201A–D with per-reactor Pre-G dosing H-201 / SF-201, KMnO₄ dosing H-202 / SF-202, powder induction SI-201 / M-201 and recirculation P-205, sulphuric- and phosphoric-acid day tanks T-201 / T-202 with P-203 / P-202, the selectable transfer pair P-206A / B, the feed and vent battery limit BL-A200, six bunds, two fire points and seven emergency stations.

findings.topic: Bank allocation — four dedicated packages vs the register
findings.reason: Each reactor needs an explicitly assigned feed, circulation and transfer arrangement.
findings.observation: The model allocates one Pre-G dosing, one KMnO₄ dosing, one powder-induction package and one recirculation pump to each of the four reactors (H-201A–D / SF-201A–D, H-202A–D / SF-202A–D, SI-201A–D / M-201A–D, P-205A–D) and one selectable transfer pair P-206A / B; LST-001 lists single H-201, H-202, SF-201, SF-202 and M-201 and P-205A / B without assigning them to four reactors. The data layer records the compound model tags as "via composite" register matches and the single register tags as not in the model; P-205C / D and the SI-201 induction packages have no register identity. DBM V2.0 sizes the bank as four reactors on a 24 h cycle staggered 6 h.
findings.action: Reconcile the four-package model with LST-001 and the P&ID — shared versus dedicated dosing, induction and recirculation, and the P-206 duty / standby basis — and add the per-reactor tags or the aliases by decision.

findings.topic: Feed and dosing — ratios approved, KMnO₄ route open
findings.status: Ratio basis approved — addition method unresolved
findings.reason: Dosing requires a known ratio basis, a defined addition route and a permissive basis.
findings.observation: D-A200-02 approves the PFD V5.1.1 denominator: 66.24 kg H₂SO₄, 6.75 kg H₃PO₄ and 4 kg KMnO₄ per kg Pre-G, carried by LST-001, LST-007, DAT-003 and MDL-001; NTE-008's per-kg-graphite ratios are superseded, with the pilot 46 kg/kg question (NTE-008 §9.2 Q6) left as a follow-up. The KMnO₄ addition method is an open conflict across all four lines — NTE-004 Option E pneumatic surface-impingement, NTE-007 Venturi eductor VE-201 with rotary valve, LST-001 twin-screw LIW feeder SF-202 → M-201 static mixer — and the model shows the LIW-feeder-plus-induction arrangement. Streams 203 / 207 and 212 / 213 are recorded as identity items; VE-201, XV-201 and DC-201 exist only in design notes.
findings.action: Verify the 66.24 kg/kg ratio against the pilot batch record (MoC on PFD-001 if the pilot recipe is the true one); decide the KMnO₄ addition method and fix the C&E permissives (agitation, temperature, N₂ blanket) before the P&ID.

findings.reason: Sampling and transfer must not inadvertently open product, waste or recovery paths; pump duties need the batch basis.
findings.observation: The model provides a recirculation pump per reactor (P-205A–D, owned by the reactor records) and the selectable transfer pair P-206A / B. LST-001 reuses stream 216 for both the recirculation take-off and the TLGO transfer to A-300 (flagged); P-205 / P-206 duties are unapproved and depend on the withdrawn batch basis. Transfer temperature 10 °C is approved (D-A200-04: PFD "chill down to 10 °C", pilot-verified in NTE-008; DAT-003 ≤ 20 °C and NTE-010 ≈ 30 °C superseded). The V119 sampling-scenario simulation is not re-run here.
findings.action: Split stream 216 on LST-001; derive P-205 / P-206 duties from CAL-011 V8; verify sample-receiver arrangements, valve fail positions and independent protection on the P&ID.

findings.status: Duty withdrawn — coolant supply conflict open
findings.reason: The connected utility must remove the peak reaction heat across the jacket; the jacket area and coolant temperature decide whether it can.
findings.observation: D-A200-01 withdrew the peak cooling duty (629 kW DAT-003 / 590 kW CAL-011 V7), the jacket area required and available and the adequacy ratio — all derived from the withdrawn batch mass — noting that the "jacket insufficient" conclusion is expected to hold or worsen on the DBM V2.0 basis. The jacket coolant supply is an open conflict: 5 °C chilled water during KMnO₄ addition (NTE-008) vs ≈ 15 °C U-201 / ≈ 25 °C (NTE-010); the A-5000 review carries the chilled-water and exchanger question. The four jacket subassemblies are model-only.
findings.action: Complete CAL-011 V8 on the DBM V2.0 basis (batch ≈ 42.9 t), then fix the peak duty, jacket adequacy and the coolant supply (chilled vs cooling water) with the A-5000 utility ruling; run reaction calorimetry (A-059).

findings.status: Impeller type in conflict — disassembly basis open
findings.reason: The agitator type sets the drive, the removal envelope and the mixing / suspension basis; maintenance must provide a physically achievable removal sequence.
findings.observation: The impeller type is an open conflict on all four reactors — retreat-curve impeller (DAT-003) vs close-clearance anchor / helical (NTE-008) — as is the bottom head (2:1 semi-elliptical with bottom outlet, DAT-003, vs conical ≥ 60°, NTE-008). The model reactor carries a top drive and head nozzles; the V119 mechanical basis recorded that the impeller envelope exceeds the cover neck bore and that split-impeller retrieval must be qualified. Vessel design temperature 80 °C and design pressure +50 mbarg / full vacuum are approved from DAT-003 (D-A200-05 / -07; the uncontrolled RFQ 3.0 barg is not adopted).
findings.action: Decide the impeller and bottom-head type with the CAL-011 V8 sizing; obtain the vendor disassembly procedure, lifted masses and rigging; confirm the relief basis before freezing the design pressure (DAT-003 15.8).

findings.reason: Residual process liquid needs an accessible, defined receiving path and an assessed capture arrangement sized to the real batch.
findings.observation: The model owns independent reactor bunds BND-201A–D (21.4 m³ retention each) and the acid-tank bunds BND-202 (39.9 m³) / BND-203 (18.9 m³), two fire points and seven emergency stations, none on LST-001. The retention figures predate the DBM V2.0 batch (≈ 42.9 t per reactor); the bottom-outlet arrangement and closed-drain destination are model conventions, not verified against a receiving-system design, and the T-203 receiver and E-201 exchanger named in design notes are in neither register nor model.
findings.action: Re-derive bund retention from the DBM V2.0 batch inventory; verify residual heel, dead legs, isolation and the closed-drain destination; rule T-203 / E-201 in or out.

findings.status: Envelope and ladder approved — relief and destination open
findings.reason: Each gas and pressure interface needs an identified function, destination and design basis; the temperature ladder is the primary safeguard of an exothermic permanganate oxidation.
findings.observation: D-A200-03 approves the temperature envelope and ladder — 47.5 °C setpoint, 45–50 °C allowable, TALL 43 / TAL 46 / TAH 49 / TAHH 50 °C (SIS) per NTE-003, consistent with PFD Safety Note 1 (≤ 49 °C) and DAT-003; NTE-010's ≈ 50 / ≈ 55 °C stages are superseded (55 °C is the non-recoverable Mn₂O₇ point of NTE-007). Nitrogen blanketing comes from the model header N2-HEADER-201 and the battery limit BL-A200; the inert-gas identity itself is open in A-6000 (D-A6000-01). Relief sizing, vent capacity and the destination in A-3000 are not established; design pressure is subject to the relief case.
findings.action: Correct NTE-010 §11 to the NTE-003 ladder before the P&ID; confirm SIL and 2oo3 architecture in LOPA; reconcile nozzle and line tags to the P&ID and fix the relief basis, vent destination (A-3000 S1) and purge demand.

findings.topic: Vessel sizing basis — the cascading decision
findings.reason: Vessel volume, batch mass, reagent quantities and cooling duty all scale with the batch basis; every downstream A-200 value follows it.
findings.observation: D-A200-01 withdrew every R-201 sizing value: working volume 12.81 (DAT-003 / Calc V6) vs 12.011 (CAL-011 V7) vs 19.8 m³ (NTE-008); total 18.3 / 17.16 / 24.7 m³; inside diameter 2.50 / 2.33 m; batch mass 21,956 (CAL-011) vs 37,581 kg (NTE-008) — each computed on a basis that DBM V2.0 / MOC-001 superseded (NTE-008 on 488 kg graphite and the 32 % pilot yield chain; CAL-011 on 398 kg Pre-G, 20 h and 46 kg/kg). Approved instead: 550 kg Pre-G per batch and a 24 h cycle staggered 6 h (DBM V2.0 §3.3 / §3.4), on which a first-principles estimate gives ≈ 42.9 t batch, 22.6–24.1 m³ working and 28–34 m³ total. The explorer therefore shows R-201 capacity as unresolved with three superseded alternatives — by decision, not by omission.
findings.action: Re-run FEED-PE-CAL-011 (V8) on the DBM V2.0 basis with the PFD V5.1.1 ratios, then revise FEED-PE-DAT-003 and the model reactor size; all A-200 duties follow.

findings.status: Ruled — ten items not yet covered
findings.reason: Concentrated sulphuric / phosphoric acid with permanganate sets glass-lined reactors, lined dosing lines and fluoropolymer or FRP day tanks.
findings.observation: D-A200-MOC applies MAT-002: R-201A–D glass-lined carbon steel with glass-lined agitator, baffles, dip pipes and thermowell; M-201 / P-205 PTFE / PFA-lined pipe and mixer with PFA-lined sealless pumps; H-202 / SF-202 316L / HDPE / PP / PVDF / PTFE per DBM §3.15.1; T-202 / P-202 PVDF, PTFE / PFA or vinyl-ester FRP. MDL-001 (XLPE / HDPE storage) superseded. Ten items — DC-201, H-201, H-202, M-201, P-203, P-206A / B, SF-201, SF-202, T-201 — keep an MDL-001 material only.
findings.action: Extend MAT-002 to the ten uncovered A-200 items (notably the sulphuric-acid day tank T-201 and pump P-203); issue datasheets on the MAT-002 base case after CAL-011 V8.

decisions.rationale: Plant-wide ruling: FEED-PE-MAT-002 'Recommended MOC (base case)' governs material of construction over FEED-PE-MDL-001 (scale-up study) and design-note wording — MAT-002 is the controlled MoC matrix and postdates MDL-001. Wording variants of the same material family are superseded by the MAT-002 statement.
decisions.gapNote: MAT-002 does not cover 10 item(s) with an MDL-001 material only (DC-201, H-201, H-202, M-201, P-203, P-206A, P-206B, SF-201, SF-202, T-201): extend MAT-002 before those MoCs are approved.

decisions.rationale: Vessel size: NTE-008 (488 kg graphite/batch on the 32 % pilot yield chain), CAL-011 V7 (398 kg Pre-G, 20 h, 46 kg/kg) and DAT-003 (Calc V6) are all computed on bases withdrawn by FEED-PE-DBM-001 V2.0 / FEED-PE-MOC-001 (550 kg Pre-G per batch, 24 h cycle, PFD ratios). No value approved.
decisions.gapNote: Re-run FEED-PE-CAL-011 (V8) on the DBM V2.0 basis: 550 kg Pre-G/batch, 24 h cycle, PFD V5.1.1 ratios (batch ≈ 42.9 t; first-principles estimate 22.6–24.1 m³ working, 28–34 m³ total at 80–70 % fill). Then revise FEED-PE-DAT-003 to V1.2 and re-check E-201/jacket duty (≈ 1.1–1.2 MW peak per reactor at the larger batch).

PFD V5.1.1 sheet FEED-PFD-0200 states the denominator explicitly (66.24 / 6.75 / 4 kg per kg Pre-G) and every register (LST-001, LST-007, DAT-003, MDL-001) carries it. NTE-008 'per kg graphite' with the pre-revision 5.67 H₃PO₄, CAL-011 46 kg/kg and NTE-005 36/5 kg/kg are superseded.

If the pilot 46 kg/kg is the true recipe, raise an MoC on PFD-001 and restate every A-200 batch mass; also reconcile DBM V2.0 chemical-demand table (5.67 kg/kg graphite) with its own §storage statement (6.7 kg/kg Pre-G).

decisions.rationale: Alarm ladder per NTE-003 (TALL 43 / TAL 46 / TAH 49 / TAHH 50 °C): consistent with PFD Safety Note 1 (≤ 49 °C), DAT-003 item 5.14/12.2 and NTE-007. NTE-010 §11 (≈ 50 / ≈ 55 °C) superseded — 55 °C is NTE-007's non-recoverable Mn₂O₇ threshold.
decisions.gapNote: Correct FEED-PE-NTE-010 §11 representative alarm/trip stages (≈ 50 / ≈ 55 °C) to the NTE-003 ladder before the R-201 P&ID is drawn; confirm SIL and 2oo3 architecture in LOPA.

PFD 'chill down to 10 °C' and NTE-008 §9.1 (pilot-verified 10 °C). DAT-003 ≤ 20 °C and NTE-010 ≈ 30 °C superseded.

DAT-003 items 4.4/4.5; NTE-008 '50–100 mbar off-gas backpressure' is the same intent; RFQ #0018 3.0 barg/FV is uncontrolled app output and is not adopted. Final value subject to relief design (DAT-003 15.8).
Full vacuum per DAT-003 item 4.5 (scrubber suction upset).
Mechanical design temperature 80 °C (DAT-003 item) approved: a vessel design margin above the 45–50 °C operating envelope, independent of the withdrawn capacity basis (D-A200-01).
